implementation.owner_under_test: D29 market button/feedback bridge + D3RuntimeBootstrap + TradeEconomySystem + D3InventorySystem
changes: Added a real InitialHarbor PlayMode bridge test using SaveSystem.NewGame, the D29 market Button, the D3 trade panel Buy/Sell Buttons, and the public D3 owner read models.
The fixture pauses and restores the real D3 Behaviour to exercise the owner-not-ready feedback boundary without injecting a fake owner or business result.

The fixture arranges insufficient-money and full-cargo boundaries in the real D3TradeState/D3InventorySystem, then verifies the existing D3 owner result and visible feedback without UI-side compensation.

current_source_revalidation.reason: Q17 修复 D29 可用性刷新覆盖最新动作反馈后，重新执行 Q16 以确认交易 owner 桥接和拒绝反馈不受影响。

checks.name: owner_not_ready_feedback
checks.evidence: Q16_TRADE_BRIDGE_PLAYMODE_R2.xml; log contains D29 feedback '市场 owner 尚未就绪；按钮已响应，请稍后再试。' and not_ready=true; trade owner remained closed

checks.name: rapid_double_click_one_owner
checks.evidence: The real D29 market Button was invoked twice before a frame boundary; log shortcut_double_click_one_owner=true and D3 remained one active trade owner

checks.name: buy_sell_one_change_per_request
checks.evidence: Real D3 Buy/Sell Buttons changed money by the current quote and cargo by exactly one unit; visible text was 购买完成 / 出售完成; log buy_success_one_change=true and sell_success_one_change=true

checks.name: insufficient_money_and_full_cargo_rejection
checks.evidence: D3 owner returned/Displayed 金币不足 and 货舱体积不足; money and cargo remained unchanged in both cases; log insufficient_funds_unchanged=true and cargo_full_unchanged=true

failed_attempts.reason: The test held D3 as Component and accessed enabled; fixed by explicit Behaviour conversion before the passing R2 run

remaining_scope: This closes the bounded D29/D3 trade bridge cases only; it does not prove native Windows Player mouse hit testing, screenshots, performance, or complete voyage/Continue flow.
Q17 still covers shipyard/preparation success, material shortage, duplicate, cancel and exception recovery.
Q03 remains BLOCKED_ASSET for imported-rig action quality; Q13 adjacent CameraFollow NaN remains open; VC-G01 remains IN_PROGRESS.
status_boundary: Q16 VERIFIED means the existing D3 business owner and D29 UI bridge produced the tested success/rejection/busy feedback and one-change state deltas in real InitialHarbor PlayMode. It is not a final game or D31 acceptance pass.
